crossRefs.note: Caleb stilled the people before Moses, and said, “Let’s go up at once, and possess it; for we are well able to overcome…
Joshua the son of Nun and Caleb the son of Jephunneh, who were of those who spied out the land, tore their clothes.
But my servant Caleb, because he had another spirit with him, and has followed me fully, him I will bring into the land…
surely you shall not come into the land concerning which I swore that I would make you dwell therein, except Caleb the…
But Joshua the son of Nun and Caleb the son of Jephunneh remained alive of those men who went to spy out the land.
For Yahweh had said of them, “They shall surely die in the wilderness.” There was not a man left of them, except Caleb…

people.name: Caleb
people.line: Faithful spy, given Hebron as inheritance

people.name: Jephunneh
people.line: The Kenizzite, father of Caleb the spy.

translations.web: These are the names of the men: Of the tribe of Judah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh.
translations.bsb: These are their names: Caleb son of Jephunneh from the tribe of Judah;
translations.kjv: And the names of the men are these: Of the tribe of Judah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh.
translations.asv: And these are the names of the men: Of the tribe of Judah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh.
